top10.introHtml: Refreshed 2026-08-11. Cars.com: 26 total found (before seat/exclude filters), 16 qualifying 4-seat convertibles shown. CarGurus: 70 total, 20 qualifying after removing 2-seat roadsters (Boxster, Z3/Z4, SLK, Thunderbird, Lexus SC, Smart Fortwo, Solstice, Miata, Corvette). AutoTrader: 37 total, 10 qualifying. TrueCar: skipped (broken body-style filter). SL-Class 'SL 500 Roadster 2D' excluded as 2-seat. Picks weighted toward low mileage, BMW/Audi/Mercedes convertibles with fabric or retractable-hardtop, and proximity to Media, PA. No confirmed manual-transmission listings found — see Manual tab.

picks.whyGood: Newest A3 Cabriolet in the bunch at just 83k miles. The B8.5-gen A3 Cab is a proper 4-seat drop-top with MMI, a well-supported 2.0T drivetrain, and modern safety kit. Private-seller car with clean title and no accidents per Cars.com filter. At $12,999 this is a strong value for the year.
picks.whatToVerify: Full soft-top cycle (open/close), headliner and rear-seat carpet for water stains, rocker sills for rust, 2.0T timing chain tensioner update (pre-2014 issue, less critical on 2016), DSG/S tronic service history. Verify convertible top motor operation.
picks.bottomLine: Newest, lowest-mile 4-seat convertible in this search — the one to beat.

picks.whyGood: Only 44,625 miles on a 20-year-old V8 grand tourer — that's exceptional. E64 650i Convertible is a head-turner with a 4.8L V8, proper 4-seat layout, and premium feel. Private seller with clean/no-accident history just 12 miles from Media. This mileage on an E6x is almost unheard of under $15k.
picks.whatToVerify: Full top cycle and hydraulic ram operation; check headliner carefully (E6x notorious for sagging). N62 V8 oil leaks (valley pan, valve cover), coolant system (brittle hoses at age), brake condition after low-use storage. VANOS rattle at startup. Verify it hasn't been garaged without exercise.
picks.bottomLine: 44k miles on a V8 BMW convertible at $12,999 — rare find that deserves a PPI first.

picks.whyGood: The W209 CLK 350 Cabriolet at 50k miles is a genuine sleeper pick. 3.5L V6, proper 4-seat fabric top, well-engineered German quality that holds up. 50k miles for a 2007 is outstanding preservation; these cars are known to be solid if maintained. Just listed (freshly on CarGurus).
picks.whatToVerify: Full soft-top cycle; rear-window seam sealing (fabric tops crack at the rear quarter); A-pillar seals for wind noise/water; M272 engine balance shaft (early W203 issue, less common on 2007 but worth noting); transmission fluid, brake fluid age. Check for top motor noise.
picks.bottomLine: 50k miles, $12,995, 4-seat luxury drop-top — an excellent value if it checks out.

picks.whyGood: Supercharged 3.0T V6 + Quattro AWD in a 4-seat cabriolet is a genuinely rare combination under $15k. The Prestige trim brings Bang & Olufsen, adaptive cruise, and full leather. 69k miles is very reasonable for a 2011.
picks.whatToVerify: S tronic (7-speed DCT) mechatronic unit — service history essential; top operation (electro-hydraulic, can leak); supercharger belt and intercooler condition; rocker panels for corrosion underneath. Quattro rear diff fluid. Expect some electrical gremlins at age.
picks.bottomLine: AWD supercharged convertible for under $14k — the performance pick if you're willing to budget for Audi maintenance.

picks.whyGood: Two miles from home — you can walk to PPI. The 2009 CLK 350 (final year W209) at 65k miles and $10,995 is priced right for the mileage. Having a local dealer makes follow-up service easy.
picks.whatToVerify: Full top cycle; rear-window defroster function; A-pillar seals; 7G-Tronic transmission fluid; M272 balance shaft wear; check undercarriage for rust (NJ-registered history? Salt?). Verify no flood or hail history.
picks.bottomLine: The local convenience pick — 2 miles away, solid miles, a known quantity you can revisit easily.

picks.whyGood: CarGurus rates this Great Price for good reason — 2015 F33 428i xDrive for $9,900. AWD, modern BMW platform, all the contemporary features. 119k miles is manageable on the turbocharged N20 if maintained. Best price-per-year on a modern BMW in this search.
picks.whatToVerify: N20 timing chain (primary concern on pre-2015 build; confirm build date); xDrive transfer case fluid; electric soft-top motor (F3x tops are more reliable than E93 but still check); coolant expansion tank. Ask for service records.
picks.bottomLine: Great Price-rated AWD 4-series for under $10k — the budget modern BMW pick.

picks.whyGood: Same S5 Cabriolet supercharged AWD formula as rank #4 but $2,700 cheaper with 22k more miles. At 91k miles and $10,900 the S5 Cab still represents unique value — no other AWD convertible at this price in the area.
picks.whatToVerify: Same as rank #4 S5. Specifically check S tronic service interval (every 40k ideally, often skipped). Supercharger drive belt visual. Top hydraulic fluid level. Ask about cam follower on the fuel pump (N/A on 3.0T but verify 2012 spec).
picks.bottomLine: The value version of the S5 Cabriolet story — same car, more miles, lower price.

picks.whyGood: 51k miles on a 2013 BMW 328i Convertible is the sweet spot — well past any early-build gremlins but with plenty of life left. The F33/E93 soft-top is a true 4-seater; the 2.0T N20 engine is refined and fuel-efficient. Sold at a Ford dealer so it's been through a trade-in inspection.
picks.whatToVerify: N20 timing chain (confirm 2013+ build has updated part); electric soft-top cycle (F33 vs E93 — verify which gen this is: 2013 transitions to F33 platform); brake and fluid condition; check for any prior Maryland salt exposure.
picks.bottomLine: Lowest-mileage modern BMW 3-series convertible in the search — worth the 31-mile drive.

picks.whyGood: Just 9 miles away, under $10k, and under 100k miles — the easy-entry Mustang. The 2012 S197 V6 (305hp 3.7L) is a genuinely capable engine and the convertible top on S197 cars is well-proven. Practical 4-seater with real American muscle style.
picks.whatToVerify: Full top cycle and latch engagement; rear-seat water stain check (S197 rear-window seal common failure); spring perch rust (critical for PA/NJ cars); 3.7L spark plugs and coolant. Rear axle clunk on takeoff. Verify 6-speed auto vs MT-82 manual.
picks.bottomLine: Close, affordable, and reliable — the no-drama entry into Mustang ownership.

picks.whyGood: Twin-turbo 300hp 3.0L straight-six at $7,900 — the cheapest horsepower in this search. The E93 335i Convertible is a genuine 4-seater; the N54 engine is beloved and serviceable. Good Deal per CarGurus at this price.
picks.whatToVerify: N54 high-pressure fuel pump (common failure), injector carbon buildup, wastegate rattle at startup. E93 electric soft-top motor (pricey to replace). Check top headliner for staining; rear rocker rust underneath. Oil separator (OFHG) leaks.
picks.bottomLine: Most horsepower for the dollar in this search — $7,900 twin-turbo BMW convertible is the enthusiast deal.

manual10.introHtml: No confirmed manual-transmission 4-seat convertibles surfaced this refresh. All listings from Cars.com, CarGurus, and AutoTrader show either Automatic or unconfirmed (null) transmission. Models in budget that can come manual (Mustang GT with MT-82, E46 330Ci with 5-speed, Pontiac Firebird T/A with T-56) could not be confirmed from SRP data alone. Visit detail pages for: 2012 Ford Mustang GT (Broomall, $14,998) and 1994 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am GT (Vineland, $14,900) to verify — the Trans Am is the strongest candidate for a T-56 6-speed.

mustangs.introHtml: 4 qualifying 2005+ Ford Mustang convertibles found across all sources. Mix of S197 (2012 GT and V6) and S550 (2018, 2020) generations. GT and EcoBoost Premium trims represented. No Shelby or Boss variants in budget. All are automatic; the 2012 GT private seller (rank #2) is an unconfirmed transmission — worth verifying for manual.

picks.whyGood: Newest 'Stang in the search by 2 years — 2020 S550 platform with modern tech, 10-speed auto, and EcoBoost 2.3T (310hp). Fred Beans Ford is a reputable franchise dealer. High miles but Ford turbocharged 4-cyl is durable when maintained.
picks.whatToVerify: Rear-window seal for water intrusion in rear seats; brake wear; EcoBoost coolant and oil change history; 10R80 transmission fluid; convertible rear camera function. S550 top seal common failure point — do a wet-weather test or simulate with hose.
picks.bottomLine: Newest and most modern, but 132k on a 2020 demands a thorough service history review.

picks.whyGood: The only GT (V8 5.0L Coyote) in the convertible results — 420hp in your driveway for $14,998. Private seller 5 miles away; no-accident/clean-title filtered. If this is an MT-82 6-speed manual, it jumps to top pick.
picks.whatToVerify: Confirm MT-82 manual vs SelectShift auto (major factor). 8.8 rear axle clunk on takeoff (common, easy fix). Spring perch rust (PA car — check bottom of coil buckets). S197 rear-window seal and top latch condition. Coyote 5.0 timing chain at 117k.
picks.bottomLine: Closest V8 Mustang convertible, just 5 miles out — worth the visit for a PPI confirmation.

picks.whyGood: S550 gen at $12,992 is the best price for a 2015+ Mustang here. EcoBoost Premium gets the 10-speed auto, MagneRide-ready chassis, and all modern safety tech. 141k miles is high but the 2.3T EcoBoost is known to reach 200k+ with maintenance.
picks.whatToVerify: Convertible top seal and drain condition (S550 top drains clog easily); rear-camera function; coolant overflow tank condition; service records for EcoBoost oil/filter changes. Check for any SYNC software recalls.
picks.bottomLine: Cheapest S550 Mustang convertible, modern safety features, but high miles demand a service history review.

picks.whyGood: Cheapest Mustang here and the only one under 100k miles — 96k on a 2012 is solid. V6 (305hp) is plenty fun and dead-reliable. 9 miles away, under $10k.
picks.whatToVerify: Spring perch rust, rear window seal, top latch wear — same S197 checklist as all these. 3.7L Cyclone V6 is very reliable; just check spark plugs and coolant. Automatic transmission fluid age.
picks.bottomLine: Best miles-per-dollar Mustang in the search — closest, cheapest, most reliable drivetrain.
